raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely asserted that “Kingdom Of Rock” had a 2007 release based on unverified, ambiguous search hints and adopted an “earliest-by-title” heuristic without disambiguating by artist or corroborating with authoritative sources. This led to recording a 2007 date and would produce the wrong comparison, contradicting credible evidence that the notable “Kingdom of Rock” (Magnus Karlsson’s Free Fall) was released in 2015, making “Was I The Wave?” (2011) the earlier album.
